alerts.title: New billable resource: NAT Gateway in us-east-1
alerts.message: NAT Gateways bill an hourly charge plus data processing fees and are one of the most common surprise costs.

alerts.title: Risk increased: EC2 Instance in us-east-1
alerts.message: Can generate compute charges while running.

alerts.title: New billable resource: Elastic IP in us-east-1
alerts.message: AWS charges hourly for every public IPv4 address, and this one is not even attached to a running resource.

alerts.title: Ongoing high-risk resource: RDS Database in us-west-2
alerts.message: RDS databases bill for compute and storage continuously. Even a stopped instance is auto-started after 7 days and keeps paying for storage.
